name: web-security-panels-pearl-card-in-hand-and-black-bank-vault
title: Iridescent credit card held in a hand, dark security statement with pills, and a black-and-white vault photo with protection pills
whatItIs: Three panels: a pale grey panel with a hand holding a rainbow-sheen glass card with a logo cut-out, a black panel 'Enterprise Grade Security for Everyday Banking' with a money-bag emoji, a grey paragraph and three dark pills (Biometric Login, Secure Banking, Encryption), and a tall black-and-white photo of an open bank vault door with 'Bank-Level Protection' and three pills.
whatItMeans: Strong and reassuring; a vault image makes security tangible while pearl cards keep it modern.
techniques: Use a vault photograph as a security metaphor.
Line feature pills under a heading.
Put an emoji inside a serious headline.
Pair a pearl card with black panels.

vocabulary.definition: A bank vault photo standing for safety.
